mapper.select: select id, username, password, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at from fs_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, username, password, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at from fs_user where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, username, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at from fs_user order by username asc

select id, username, display_name, enabled, created_at, updated_at from fs_user where username like concat('%', #{q,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or coalesce(display_name, '') like concat('%', #{q,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') order by username asc
mapper.insert: insert into fs_user(username, password, display_name, enabled, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) values(#{user.username}, #{user.password}, #{user.displayName}, #{user.enabled}, #{actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update fs_user set display_name = #{user.displayName}, enabled = #{user.enabled}, updated_by = #{actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() where id = #{user.id}
update fs_user set password = #{password,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_by = #{actor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: select count(distinct u.id) from fs_user u inner join fs_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id inner join fs_role r on r.id = ur.role_id and r.code = 'ADMIN' where coalesce(u.enabled, 1) = 1
select r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description from fs_role r inner join fs_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.code
mapper.insert: insert into fs_user_role(user_id, role_id, created_at, updated_at) values(#{userId}, #{roleId}, now(), now())
